figures.shows: The Scene view while the checkpoint scene plays, with crates pushed along the directional zone's arrow and away from the spherical zone
figures.caption: Crates pushed from their rows by both zones, whose gizmos show.
figures.alt: The editor in play mode: crates out of their rows, a green sphere and a green arrow.
figures.blocked: The pin has no wind zone: the component, its system and its gizmo exist only in an editor that the reader builds from the capstone chain's patches.

figures.shows: The Scene view with a spherical zone's sphere and a directional zone's arrow, both zones selected
figures.caption: The sphere of the spherical zone and the arrow of the directional one.
figures.alt: The Scene view with a green sphere around one zone and a green arrow at the other.
figures.blocked: The pin has no wind zone, so no editor of the pin draws its sphere or its arrow; only an editor built from the capstone chain's patches does.

figures.shows: The Inspector of a directional zone with the Radius row disabled
figures.caption: The dimmed Radius row of a directional zone.
figures.alt: The Inspector of a wind zone with the Radius row dimmed.
figures.blocked: The pin has no wind zone and so no reason for its Radius row; the reason's tooltip also needs the pointer, which a take cannot place.

figures.shows: A top view of two zones with crates: a directional zone turned to blow along minus X pushes every crate the same way, and a spherical zone of radius 5 m pushes the crates inside it away from its center
figures.caption: Seen from above, the directional zone pushes every crate the same way, and the spherical zone pushes only the crates inside its radius, away from its center.
figures.alt: Left, a green arrow at a zone and eight crates, each with an equal orange arrow to the left. Right, a green circle around a zone, orange arrows pointing away from its center, and a crate outside with none.

figures.shows: The two gizmo shapes of a wind zone: a wire sphere of Radius around a spherical zone, and an arrow 2 m long along a directional zone's minus Z, both in the collider color
figures.caption: The two gizmo shapes, both in the collider color: a sphere of the radius as typed, and an arrow 2 meters long where the wind blows.
figures.alt: Left, three green circles form a sphere around a dot, with a dashed line marked Radius. Right, a green arrow leaves a dot, marked 2 m along minus Z.
figures.numbers: The arrow's length is c_WindArrowLength, 2 m, which the patch writes in PhysicsComponents.cpp (the page's section Draw the arrow, step 3).

figures.alt: The Inspector of the robot with a controller set and the Clip row below it dimmed.
